reviews.title: Wam, Ram, thank you ma'am!
reviews.comment: Easy install. My laptop originally had 12 gb of ram.Now 20gb. I tried finding another 12, but I couldn't find any, so I settled for 8gb. This is still good because the two channels will use 8gb each leaving 4gb unused in order to even it out. 16gb total I will be using, and that's enough for me to run Adobe applications for school ,and some high end games I own. Highly recommend this product and make sure you get the right Kind of DDR version. I Will buy again in the future for future product upgrades. Also wanted to note that when i turned on my computer the screen was black for a while like a slow startup since the computer recognized something new, but running applications I can see a difference in speed. It boots up faster. ⚡Man thats powa. I Recommend a restart after turning on to check the ram status.
reviews.author: Israel Resendiz Carrillo

reviews.title: My Laptop Went From “Please Don’t” to “Let’s Go”
reviews.comment:
It was a dark and stormy Tuesday. My laptop wheezed as I dared to open Roblox. The game stuttered, lagged, and generally performed like it was running on a potato with ambitions. Task Manager read like a horror novel, 97% memory usage, the cursor frozen mid-click like it had given up on life itself.
Streaming it on Discord? Forget it. The mere suggestion would send my RAM into a full existential crisis. Black screen. Audio cutting out. My friends on the call listening to the sound of my laptop slowly dying.
I had accepted my fate. Then I found this RAM.
Installation was a spiritual experience. I popped the back panel, seated the stick, and powered on with the cautious optimism of a man who has been disappointed before. The boot screen appeared. Windows loaded. I opened Roblox.
It ran smoothly.
I sat there waiting for the stutter. It never came. So I did the unthinkable, I started streaming it to Discord. Live. In real time. To my friends who had previously only known the sound of my suffering.
Nothing crashed.
16GB. Sixteen. The number felt illegal.
My only regret is not doing this sooner. The RAM delivered. My laptop survived. I am a new man.
10/10 — would upgrade my memory again, unlike my laptop which clearly could not.
reviews.author: Mr. Shopper
